⚔ Tactical encounter
⚔ Combat encounter

Enter your own natural d20 roll when a concentration save is pending.

The AI DM creates encounters automatically. You roll your own initiative and attacks. Enemies use local dice and provisional starter profiles. The diagram is an abstract distance overview, not a square-grid tactical map. Companion locations are shown only if they are combat actors. Monster profiles are provisional, not verified 2024 stat blocks. No manual enemy entry.

Position & movement

Abstract distance in feet; no terrain, cover, or grid yet. Enemy reactions and spell effects remain incomplete.

Combat effects & concentration

DM adjudicates conditions; the engine enforces selected attack effects. These controls are temporary until automatic spell/monster effects are integrated.

Turn tracker, initiative, AC, hit/miss, critical damage, Sneak Attack and HP. AI encounter triggers use preset starter profiles; 2024 combat is still incomplete: full spell lists, spell preparation, Counterspell, movement grids, complete monster actions, and other reactions need further work.

Spellcasting, Reactions & Damage

Rules-assisted prototype; spell eligibility and preparation are not fully validated. Shield reaction is currently implemented only for Wizard and Sorcerer (and future Artificer support); other reaction spells, Counterspell, and full spell preparation remain unsupported.

Reactions reset at the start of your next turn. Shield is offered when an enemy attack hits.

Damage effects

Resistance choice applies to the player’s next weapon/spell hit against the selected target. Temporary HP absorbs damage before normal HP.

Character Sheet

Portrait

Choose a built-in portrait or upload your own. Presets are suggested by species, class and gender.

More portraits: Wikimedia Commons fantasy gallery (check each image license before using). Paste a direct HTTPS image URL below or upload a downloaded image.

Uploads are resized and stored on this device. To find portraits, use the image search link below and respect artists' rights.

Character Creator

Rule-guided builder: choose a class, species and background. Apply & Save Character and background bonuses to calculate scores and HP. Existing imported stats remain unchanged until you save. Origin feats are assigned by background; subclass options unlock at level 3. Other class and species features are not yet automated. Finalization locks your choices.

🛡 Armor & AC (automatic)

A shield requires a free hand and proficiency to use without penalties. Armor proficiency, Strength requirements, Stealth disadvantage, magic items and other conditional bonuses are not fully enforced. Monk and Barbarian unarmored formulas apply automatically when no armor is equipped.

2024 Point Buy helper

Set six base scores (8–15) using 27 points. Choose base scores and apply permitted background bonuses. Final scores are calculated automatically.

HP uses fixed average on level-up. No manual maximum HP override. AC is calculated from equipped armor, shield, Dexterity, and class features. Magic armor and special bonuses are not yet modeled.

Your full backstory is saved locally. The AI receives a shorter excerpt to fit its context.

Skills & Expertise

Choose class skill proficiencies and Rogue Expertise. Background and species proficiencies will be expanded later.

✨ Spell & Rest Readiness · 7.30
Read-only view of your current spell-slot capacity, remaining slots and rest recovery. Rest still requires DM confirmation. This panel does not cast spells or spend resources.


🪄 Casting Rules · 7.34


Spell action reference for currently implemented spells. Shield uses your Reaction; other implemented spells use the Magic action. This is not a complete 2024 spell library.







🪄 Casting Integrity · 7.33
Audits combat spell-slot synchronization, pending concentration checks, and available combat actions. Read-only: no spells are cast, no turns are consumed.
⚔ Combat Casting Guard · 7.32
Read-only turn and concentration status. Use the tactical encounter's Cast Spell button to spend an action and slot together; the Journal manual slot button is disabled during active combat.
✨ Spell Resource Control · 7.31
Player-controlled spell slot spending. Select a slot level and confirm after the spell is resolved. Rest recovery remains in the existing Short/Long Rest actions; this panel never rests automatically.
⚔️ Combat Turn Integrity · 7.37
Checks initiative rotation, skipped defeated enemies, player Action/Bonus Action reset, Reaction refresh and Shield expiration. Tests use isolated mock combat data, not your campaign.


🛡️ Temporary HP & Reaction · 7.36


Damage absorbed by Temporary HP still requires a Concentration save. The DC uses the full post-resistance damage, not only the HP lost. Reactions refresh at the start of the creature's next turn.





🎯 Concentration Integrity · 7.35
Each damaging hit can require a separate Constitution save. Pending saves are queued instead of overwritten. At 0 HP, concentration ends. Player rolls remain player-controlled.

💾 SoloQuest 8.9 — Save Reliability
Read-only storage diagnostics, manual recovery snapshot and JSON backup validation. Snapshots stay on this device; export JSON separately for protection against browser data loss.
🧭 SoloQuest 8.8 — State Consistency
Read-only campaign audit. Detects invalid combat turn pointers, duplicate actor IDs, HP mismatches and invalid turn resources. No automatic changes to your campaign.
🧪 8.7 Combat Integration
Cross-system checks: initiative, turn reset, concentration, temporary HP, conditions, cover, stealth and Assassin. Runs with isolated sample combat state.
🧷 SoloQuest 8.6 — Conditions Integrity
Grappled and Restrained set Speed to 0. Incapacitated, Stunned and Unconscious end Concentration. Conditions are DM-adjudicated; Grapple escape and all spell interactions are not automated.
👁️ SoloQuest 8.5 — Sight & Cover (DM ruling)
Set visibility and cover manually. Coordinates do not prove line of sight. Total cover prevents direct attacks; half/three-quarters cover grants +2/+5 AC. Obscured and Invisible targets apply unseen-target disadvantage; full darkness, lighting, and detection remain subject to DM adjudication.
🔎 Enemy Search · 8.4
When an enemy targets a hidden PC, it spends its Action searching instead of attacking. Search uses a provisional +0 Perception modifier until a creature stat block supplies one. No automatic reveal for missing Hide DC. No map-based line of sight yet.
🕵️ Stealth & Detection · 8.3
Hide requires DC 15 Dexterity (Stealth) and appropriate cover or obscurement. The successful check total is stored as the detection DC. Enemy detection still requires an explicit adjudicated Perception check; this panel does not roll for the player or reveal the character automatically.
No active stealth check.
🗡️ Rogue Combat Refinement · 8.2
Cunning Action requires Rogue level 2+, your turn, an unused Bonus Action, and no pending dice interaction. Hide still requires player confirmation of concealment and line of sight; the battlefield does not model cover automatically.
🗡️ Assassin · 8.1
Assassinate: Advantage on Initiative. During the first round, Advantage against a creature that has not taken its turn. If Sneak Attack hits during the first round, extra damage equals Rogue level.
⚔️ Attack Integrity · 8.0
Read-only attack math tests: natural 1/20, critical dice, Sneak Attack prerequisites and once-per-turn usage. Assassin subclass special features remain pending.
